blocks.text: Breadth-First Search (BFS) graph traversal algorithm hai jo graph ke tamam nodes level ba level (pehle qareeb wale nodes, phir door wale) dekhta hai, ek diye gaye node se shuru kar ke (jise aksar root kehte hain). Jin nodes ko abhi dekhna baqi hai un ka hisab rakhne ke liye yeh queue (qataar: jo pehle aaye woh pehle nikle) istemal karta hai.

items: Root node se shuru karein aur use queue mein dalein (enqueue).
Queue se ek node nikalein (dequeue), use process karein, aur us ke tamam na dekhe gaye (unvisited) neighbors (saath jure nodes) queue mein dal dein.
Yeh process queue khali hone tak dohrayein.

blocks.text: Misal: social network graph mein har node ek insaan aur har edge dosti hai. BFS se do logon ke darmiyan sab se chhota raasta (shortest path) dhoonda ja sakta hai, maslan do users ke darmiyan degree of separation (kitne doston ke zariye jure hain).
Complexity: BFS ki time complexity O(V + E) hai, jahan V vertices (nodes) ki ginti aur E edges ki ginti hai. Is liye yeh bare graphs dekhne ke liye efficient hai.

Yeh program doston ke chhote network par BFS chalata hai aur har shakhs ki degree of separation (kitne doston ke zariye jura hai) print karta hai. start ko kisi aur naam (maslan "Omar") se badal kar Run karein.

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"friends = {...}": dictionary (naam se list) jis mein har shakhs ke dost hain; yeh ek graph hai.
"start = \"Ali\"": BFS kahan se shuru ho.
"distance = {start: 0}": har shakhs ki degree of separation; Ali khud 0 par. Yeh "visited" ka record bhi hai.
"queue = [start]": queue (qatar) mein pehle Ali.
"person = queue.pop(0)": qatar ke aage wale ko nikalta hai (dequeue) aur "Visit ..." print karta hai.
"for friend in friends[person]: if friend not in distance:": jo dost abhi tak dekha nahi gaya, us ki degree = is shakhs ki degree + 1, aur use qatar ke peeche daal do (append).
"if start in friends:": start ka naam network mein na ho to message deta hai.
Output: "Visit Ali - degree 0", "Visit Sara - degree 1", "Visit Bilal - degree 1", "Visit Hina - degree 2", "Visit Omar - degree 2", "Visit Zara - degree 3". Pehle tamam degree 1 wale, phir degree 2, phir 3: level ba level.
Khud try karein: start = "Omar" kar ke Run karein: Omar 0, Bilal 1, Ali aur Hina 2, Sara aur Zara 3.

blocks.prompt: Root 0, us ke bachche 1, 2, 3, aur pote 4, 5 (1 ke neeche), 6 (2 ke neeche) aur 7 (3 ke neeche) wale tree (Figure 3.8) mein BFS kis tarteeb se nodes dekhta hai?

items: BFS: queue, level ba level; do logon ke darmiyan shortest path; O(V + E).
